title: AreaSurvival
description: it is a SMP with a custom plugin that only drops your loot when your killed by a player, has claims and teams and has different hoppers that are craftable with custom hopper speeds. It also has voicechat and now Minecraft Bedrock crossplay support.
body: Its a SMP with a custom plugin that makes your items only drop when killed by a player, it also has claims, homes, teams and custom crafting recipes for faster hoppers. It also has Simplevoicechat and Crossplay.
